sub_theme: Our Local Area: Then and Now

lessons.title: Non-Fiction: Our Area Long Ago
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about how the local area used to look.
success_criteria: I can find a fact about the area's past.
I can answer a question using the text.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children think the area looked like 100 years ago.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a simple text/using old photos about the local area's history.
lessons.independent_task: Children read/view and answer retrieval questions about the area's past.
resources_needed: Local history text or old photographs
key_questions: What did the area look like then?
Where did you find that fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences using evidence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note non-fiction/photographic retrieval skill — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap facts found about the area's past.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member what the area used to look like.

lessons.title: Addition to 100 Using a Number Line
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to add two-digit numbers using a number line.
success_criteria: I can add using a number line.
I can add tens and ones separately.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model adding two-digit numbers using a number line, partitioning into tens and ones.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve two-digit addition problems using a number line.
key_questions: How many jumps of ten?
What is the total?

differentiation.support: Add a two-digit and one-digit number

lessons.assessment_notes: Record extension of addition to two-digit numbers — evidence for MATHS.N2.

lessons.title: How Has Our High Street Changed?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a change in the local high street/shops over time.
success_criteria: I can name a shop type from the past.
I can compare it to shops today.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at an old photo of a high street/shops.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how shops have changed (types of shops, shopfronts, signage).
lessons.independent_task: Children compare an old and new shop picture, recording changes noticed.
resources_needed: Old and new shop/high street picture cards
key_questions: What has changed about this shop?
What has stayed the same?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note change over time understanding using photographic evidence — evidence for HIST.2.
lessons.home_link: Look at shops in your area and think about how long they might have been there.

lessons.title: Transport in Our Local Area: Then and Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how transport in the local area has changed.
success_criteria: I can name a type of transport used in the past.
I can compare it to transport today.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss transport children see in the local area today.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how local transport has changed (horse and cart, trams, buses, cars).
lessons.independent_task: Children compare old and new transport pictures relevant to the local area.
resources_needed: Old and new transport picture cards
key_questions: How did people travel around here in the past?
How is it different now?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give reasoning for why transport has changed

lessons.assessment_notes: Note change over time applied to a geography/history crossover — evidence for GEOG.2/HIST.2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how your family travels around the local area.

lessons.title: Using 'When' and 'Because' to Compare
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use subordinating conjunctions to compare then and now.
success_criteria: I can use 'when' in a sentence.
I can use 'because' in a sentence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the high street comparison from Monday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model using 'when' and 'because' to link ideas comparing then and now.
lessons.independent_task: Children write sentences using 'when' and 'because' to compare the local area then and now.
key_questions: Can you use 'because' to explain a change?
Can you use 'when' to describe timing?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 4+ varied sentences using both conjunctions

lessons.assessment_notes: Note use of subordinating conjunctions — evidence for ENG.W3.
lessons.home_link: Make up a sentence using 'because' at home.

lessons.title: Subtraction to 100 Using a Number Line
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to subtract two-digit numbers using a number line.
success_criteria: I can subtract using a number line.
I can subtract tens and ones separately.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model subtracting two-digit numbers using a number line, partitioning into tens and ones.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve two-digit subtraction problems using a number line.
key_questions: How many jumps back?
What is left?

differentiation.support: Subtract a one-digit number from a two-digit number

lessons.assessment_notes: Record extension of subtraction to two-digit numbers — evidence for MATHS.N2.

lessons.title: Interviewing About Local Changes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to prepare questions to ask about local history.
success_criteria: I can prepare a question about local history.
I can explain what I'd like to find out.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap local history facts gathered so far.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model preparing clear questions to ask an older person about the local area's history.
lessons.independent_task: Children prepare 2-3 questions to ask a family member/older person about local history.
key_questions: What would you like to find out?
How will you ask that question clearly?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note historical enquiry skill: forming questions — evidence for HIST.2.
lessons.home_link: Ask your prepared questions to a family member or older person.

lessons.title: Land Use in Our Local Area
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how land is used in the local area.
success_criteria: I can name a way land is used (housing, shops, park).
I can say if this has likely changed.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what the land near school is used for.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss types of land use (residential, commercial, green space) in the local area.
lessons.independent_task: Children record different land uses seen in the local area, considering how they might have changed.
key_questions: What is this land used for?
Has it always been used this way?

differentiation.greater_depth: Identify 5+ land uses and discuss change

lessons.assessment_notes: Note land use vocabulary and change reasoning — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Notice different land uses on a walk with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Then-and-Now Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read words comparing then and now.
success_criteria: I can read then-and-now words.
I can read a comparison sentence.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to then/now themed words.
lessons.independent_task: Children read comparison sentence cards about the local area then and now.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this comparison sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading then-and-now words over the week.

lessons.title: Local Area Data: Building a Pictogram
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct and interpret a pictogram about local area features.
success_criteria: I can build a pictogram.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model constructing a pictogram of local feature types (e.g. shops, houses, parks counted on a walk/map).
lessons.independent_task: Children build a pictogram from local area data and answer questions about it.
key_questions: Which feature is most common?
How many more of this than that?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record data handling skill extended to Year 2 — evidence for MATHS.STAT.
lessons.home_link: Make a simple pictogram of something at home.

lessons.title: Buildings Then and Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare building styles from the past to today.
success_criteria: I can describe an old building style.
I can compare it to a modern building.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at pictures of old and new local buildings.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how building styles and materials have changed over time.
lessons.independent_task: Children compare an old and new building, recording differences noticed.
resources_needed: Old and new building picture cards
key_questions: What is different about this old building?
What materials does the modern building use?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note change over time in the built environment — evidence for HIST.2.
lessons.home_link: Notice old and new buildings near your home.

lessons.title: Drawing a Map of Our Local Area
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to draw a simple map of the local area including a key.
success_criteria: I can draw key local features.
I can create a simple map key.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model drawing a simple map with symbols and a key.
lessons.independent_task: Children draw their own simple map of the local area, creating a key for their symbols.
key_questions: What symbol will you use for this feature?
What does your key show?

differentiation.greater_depth: Include 6+ features with a detailed key

lessons.assessment_notes: Note map-making skill, a key geography enquiry skill — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Draw a simple map of your street or route to school.

lessons.title: Reporting Back on Our Interviews
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to report findings from an interview clearly.
success_criteria: I can share what I found out.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the interviews conducted (home link from Tuesday).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how to report findings clearly and in order.
lessons.independent_task: Children report back their interview findings about local history to a small group.
key_questions: What did you find out?
What was most interesting?

differentiation.greater_depth: Report unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and historical enquiry reporting — evidence for ENG.SL1/HIST.2.
lessons.home_link: Share your interview findings with your family.

lessons.title: Multiplication Recap: 2, 5 and 10 Times Tables
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall multiplication facts for 2, 5 and 10.
success_criteria: I can recall 2 times table facts.
I can recall 5 or 10 times table facts.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model multiplication facts for 2, 5 and 10 using arrays and grouping.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise recalling and applying 2, 5 and 10 times table facts.
key_questions: What is 3 x 5?
Can you make an array to show this?

differentiation.support: Focus on 2 and 10 times tables with counters

lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline check on multiplication tables for the term — evidence for MATHS.N3.
lessons.home_link: Practise the 2, 5 and 10 times tables together.

lessons.title: What Would We Add to Improve Our Local Area?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to suggest an improvement for the local area with reasoning.
success_criteria: I can suggest an improvement.
I can give a reason for it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's local area learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss thinking like a geographer/planner — what could make the area better?
lessons.independent_task: Children draw and describe one improvement they'd suggest for the local area.
key_questions: What would you add or change?
Why would this help?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reasoning for the suggestion

lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of geographical thinking to a real-world suggestion — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Discuss an improvement idea for your area with your family.

lessons.title: Local Area Then and Now Quiz
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about the local area then and now.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about the local area then and now, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What has changed about our local area?
Why might buildings look different today?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on local area then-and-now facts.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Addition, Subtraction, Data
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply addition, subtraction and data handling skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can add and subtract two-digit numbers.
I can read a pictogram.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of two-digit addition/subtraction and pictograms.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 2 stations: addition/subtraction, data handling.
key_questions: What is the total?
What does the pictogram show?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 3 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.N2/STAT.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining both skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising two-digit addition and subtraction over the weekend.

lessons.title: Local Area Then and Now Topic Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about how the local area has changed.
success_criteria: I can name a way the area has changed.
I can name a way it's stayed the same.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's history and geography learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss synthesising the week's learning about local change over time.
lessons.independent_task: Contribute to a class 'Our Area: Then and Now' display combining photographs, interviews, and maps from the week.
key_questions: What have we learned about how our area has changed?
What was most interesting?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning, completing this local history mini-topic — evidence for HIST.2/GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished 'Our Area: Then and Now' display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about your area's history with your family.
